outcome: Newborns born small for gestational age
cohort: Pregnant women attending a tertiary referral hospital in Taiwan during the Omicron wave of the COVID-19 pandemic (April 29 to July 30, 2022).
finding: Paxlovid was effective in shortening the duration of COVID-19-associated symptoms and was safe for pregnant women during the Omicron wave, although a higher proportion of caesarean deliveries was observed in the treated group.
mod_finding: A higher proportion of caesarean delivery rates was observed among paxlovid-treated women compared to the group without antiviral treatment.
